seoTitle: Katy ISD Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Katy ISD 2026–27 starts Aug. 12. Fall Break is Oct. 9–13, Spring Break is Mar. 8–12, and the last day is May 26. View the official PDF or download an ICS file.
heroSourceLine: 2026–27 instructional calendar · Reviewed against the official Katy ISD PDF
heroSummary: Katy ISD starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and ends with early dismissal on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The new Fall Break runs October 9–13, and Spring Break is March 8–12.
sourceCalendarName: Katy Independent School District 2026–27 Instructional Calendar PDF
sourceReviewSummary: We checked the dates and district terminology against Katy ISD's amended 2026–27 instructional calendar. We also reviewed the district's calendar-amendment announcement, Back to School page, and 2026–27 Student Handbook. The two official sources list different junior high early-release times, so both are noted on this page.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: What we checked in the official sources
sourceReviewDetails: On August 10, 2026, the official Katy ISD calendar link returned the amended 2026–27 PDF. Source file checksum (SHA-256): a0c48651…81f7bb09.
The calendar lists 81 instructional days in the fall and 91 in the spring, for 172 total. It also states that sufficient minutes are included to cover two bad-weather days.

Katy ISD's January 20, 2026 announcement says Fall Break was added and the early-graduation option for seniors was removed. That announcement calls May 26, 2027 a Thursday, but the official calendar grid and the date itself place May 26 on Wednesday; this page uses Wednesday.
Official event terminology is preserved where practical. Familiar break labels are used when they make an official holiday range easier for families to identify.
sourceNextReviewText: Next review: when Katy ISD revises the 2026–27 instructional calendar or changes the official resource linked from its calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for Katy ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD Fall Break runs Friday, October 9 through Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Classes resume Wednesday, October 14.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD Spring Break runs Monday, March 8 through Friday, March 12, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 15.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a Campus Day with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Katy ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is early dismissal in Katy ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: On December 18, 2026 and May 26, 2027, Katy ISD lists early dismissal at 12:05 p.m. for Tier A elementary schools, 12:25 p.m. for mid-tier elementary schools, 12:45 p.m. for Tier B elementary schools, and 11:35 a.m. for high schools. For junior high schools, the district's Back to School page lists 1:05 p.m., while the 2026–27 Student Handbook lists 1:10 p.m. Confirm the time with your campus.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Katy ISD calendar, and how many bad-weather days does it cover?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD has 172 instructional days in 2026–27: 81 in the fall semester and 91 in the spring. The district calendar says it contains enough operational minutes to cover two bad-weather days.
